The supplied regulatory result found no validated gross-area screening threshold; the 4.0 m² per child standard applies to specified net areas, while the source also lists a 60 m² minimum net useful area for the facility. The dataset’s 86 m² surface area cannot establish whether that net requirement or the 10 m² staff and reception provision can be met. The applicable authorization regime may depend on the transition to D.G.R. 3-1937/2025 and must be checked at the application date. Urban-planning compatibility, change-of-use permissions, sanitary and accessibility requirements, fire safety where applicable, structural safety, and sector authorization also require verification.
pros: Existing commercial unit and 86 m² stated surface provide a basis for conversion assessment, subject to verifying usable internal layout and regulatory requirements.
Energy class D meets the user’s stated preference; renewable energy is recorded as present in the dataset.
Green proximity score of 75.6 supports the preference for access to parks or green areas.
cons: Gross area does not establish compliance with the 60 m² net useful facility minimum or the separate 10 m² provision; the 4.0 m² per child standard concerns designated net areas, not total property area.
The authorization regime is subject to regulatory transition; applicability of D.G.R. 3-1937/2025 and the sector procedure must be verified when applying.
PRG compatibility, change-of-use title, sanitary conditions, accessibility, fire safety where prescribed, and structural and seismic safety are unverified.
